XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Failure of horn and steering wheel controls, with airbag warning light illuminated.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Device: Rotary switch

  • Fault: The vehicle’s horn and all steering wheel controls are not functioning, and the airbag warning light on the instrument panel has come on suddenly

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B1000 (Airbag actuator – Resistance too high)
    • B1162 (Gear selector lock switch – Implausible signal)
    • U0212 (CAN data bus, steering column control unit – Loss of communication)
  • Cause: Faulty rotary contact

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the rotary contact and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In the case in question, after replacing the rotary contact, the warning "Driver assistance system button defective" appeared on the instrument panel display when the engine was started. The fault was therefore permanently resolved by reprogramming using diagnostic equipment.
    The faulty component showed no visual faults and is accessible from the passenger compartment under the steering wheel, after removing the airbag module.
